name: the universe
description: events that happened before there was an earth, or far beyond it.

events.text: the big bang: space, time, matter, and energy begin expanding from an extremely hot, dense state
about 380,000 years after the big bang, the first atoms form and light travels freely for the first time; it survives today as the cosmic microwave background
the first stars ignite, made almost entirely of hydrogen and helium
early galaxies take shape, including the oldest parts of our own milky way
a cloud of gas and dust, enriched by the remains of earlier stars, collapses to form the sun and a disk of material around it
the soviet union launches sputnik 1, the first artificial satellite
yuri gagarin becomes the first human in space
valentina tereshkova becomes the first woman in space
apollo 11: neil armstrong and buzz aldrin walk on the moon
